title: After third straight loss, should Colts bench Daniel Jones for Anthony Richardson Sr.?
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver recap the Indianapolis Colts' third straight loss, this time against the Minnesota Vikings. title: The Vikings Are Undefeated With No Offense & a John Harbaugh Masterclass
text: Conor Orr and Albert Breer break down the Week 7 NFL action and how the Minnesota Vikings are starting to resemble the 2000 Baltimore Ravens, with their strong defense and lackluster offense. title: Week 7 recap: Seahawks = still very good, Bengals offense explodes & are the Ravens done?
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: Week 7 brought us its fair share of impressive performances. The Cincinnati Bengals used a 35-point run in the second half to throttle the Baltimore Ravens. The Minnesota Vikings kept doing things their way and got to 6-0 with a 16-10 win over the Indianapolis Colts. Going back to Thursday, the Chicago Bears won a thriller over the New England Patriots. Will any of those teams get seats at the TAFS Contenders Table? And what more did we learn in Week 7? Robert Mays, Derrik Klassen and Dave Helman break it all down on this episode of The Athletic Football Show.
